headline: EnQuest and SSE Signal Withdrawal from UK Fossil Fuel Projects
summary: North Sea operator EnQuest plans to exit the oil basin, while SSE has threatened to close a gas storage site in Yorkshire. Both companies cited disagreements with government policies as the reason for pulling investment from these fossil fuel projects.
why: The UK government's energy transition policies are creating friction with legacy energy companies, affecting the domestic supply of oil and gas.

impacts.name: EnQuest
impacts.why: The decision to exit the North Sea basin significantly alters the company's long-term asset portfolio.
